answer: Continuous physical-presence attestation. Each identity must periodically submit a reading from a local sensor suite only a real deployment occupies, e.g. soil-moisture drift in tundra permafrost plots or water-chemistry traces in karst aquifers. Enforcement: readings are checked against a site-specific physical model; a falcon-tagged unit's sequence must match its registered site's observed noise signature within tolerance. An attacker faking N identities must physically instrument N distinct sites and maintain them, paying hardware, travel, and upkeep per identity.
